Young scientists and engineers are invited to explore, build, test, and discover through STEM presentations. Each month features a new challenge designed to spark curiosity, encourage problem-solving, and make learning fun through play. 
Times: 11 am & 2:30 pm 
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now.
*Members do not require a reservation
*Events and dates are subject to change. 
Frequently Asked Questions 
What age is this activity designed for?
STEM Up to the Challenge is designed for young learners and their families. 
Do I need to attend the entire program?
No. Families are welcome to join during the scheduled program times.

What STEM skills will children practice?
Children will explore observation, counting, prediction, problem-solving, and early engineering concepts.

About the play partner:
Platinum Performing Arts is a non-profit dance and theatre studio located in Orange. Our mission focuses on making high-quality performing arts classes and experiences welcoming and accessible to all. Through our inclusion program, All Abilities classes and scholarship options we hope to help every child shine onstage.
About the play partner: Backhausdance is Orange County’s award-winning contemporary dance nonprofit dedicated to creating and performing bold, innovative work that inspires, challenges and uplits. Through transformative education and inclusive community engagement, we empower the next generation of artists and enrich the cultural pulse of Southern California. Our vision: Dance Every Day for Every Body!

events.title: Neurodivergent Family Night
events.description:
Join us for a free evening where children and caretakers are invited to play in a sensory-friendly, neuro-affirming environment! We encourage the whole family to attend, and therapists can join as well.
Neurodivergent Family Nights are held on the second Tuesday and fourth Thursday of each month from 5-7 pm (after we close to general admission).
On these nights, we dim the lights in the museum, turn off the sounds, and offer a limited capacity of 250 guests. Staff are happy and ready to assist with providing various materials, including noise-cancelling headphones, fidget toys, sunglasses, and weighted materials for your convenience.

Niagara Cares is the heart of what we do and who we are at Niagara Bottling. For more than 60 years, we have been making a difference for our Team Members, consumers and communities through philanthropic giving, volunteering, water donations, and disaster relief. As a family-owned business, we are committed to creating meaningful change for our communities through a spirit of giving back both big and small. For more information, visitniagarawater.com/niagara-cares.
Frequently Asked Questions:
Is Sustainable Saturdays included with museum admission?
Yes. All Sustainable Saturdays activities are included with regular museum admission.

Sustainable Saturdays is held on the fourth Saturday of every month in the Art Studio.

events.description:
Kaelynn Partlow is an autistic therapist, public speaker, content creator, and author of Life on the Bridge. She is best known for her appearance on the Netflix series Love on the Spectrum, where she became a recognizable and relatable voice for autism advocacy. Through her social media platforms, Kaelynn reaches millions with a message of meaningful inclusion, practical strategies, and systemic change.

events.title: Meet the Author Food Tasting with Glenda Galván-García
events.display_title: Meet the Author Food Tasting with Glenda Galván-García
events.description:
Join author and Executive Chef Glenda Galván-García for a special storytime inspired by La Enchilada Completa. Families will learn about the rich traditions of Mexican cuisine, enjoy a live guacamole demonstration and tasting, and explore how food brings people together. 
TIMES: 11am & 2:30pm
About the play partner: 
Glenda Galván-García is the Executive Chef at Granville’s award-winning restaurants in LA, as well as consultant for companies such as Mission Tortillas, Whole Foods, and Taco Bell. Proudly Chicana, she loves sharing principles of Mexican culture through food. The Whole Enchilada is her first foray into middle-grade literature. She lives in Orange County, CA.
